wikitext:
[[File:BracketMatchPlayers2.png|frameless|right]] This is a subtemplate that you will never use directly. It only renders the '''header row''' of the popups. It handles team1, team1flag and team1lineup to the left, and team2, team2flag and team2lineup to the right. After it, {{Tl|BracketMatchSummary}} renders all rows below, like date, maps, scores, overtime, etc. === BracketMatchPlayers === [[File:BracketMatchPlayers.png|frameless|left]] For non-2on2 contexts, used by most brackets, where you want both teamname and teamlineups shown in the header, see {{Tl|BracketMatchPlayers}}. It handles Player/team1 and Player/team1flag to the left, and Player/team2 + Player/team2flag to the right.



Adapted from [http://wiki.teamliquid.net/starcraft2/Template:BracketMatchPlayers Liquipedia]
